title: Language Model Core Interfaces
summary: This module defines the fundamental interfaces and utilities for interacting with language models, including message representation, prompt engineering, model implementations, and output parsing. It provides the building blocks for integrating and controlling LLMs within LangChain.

nodes.label: User Input
nodes.title: User Provided Input
nodes.description: The initial text, query, or data provided by the user or application, which serves as the starting point for LLM interaction.

nodes.label: Prompt Engineering
nodes.title: Prompt Engineering Module
nodes.description: Manages the creation, formatting, and templating of prompts for language models, including chat and string-based prompts, handling input variables and partial application.

nodes.label: Message Handling
nodes.title: Message Handling Module
nodes.description: Provides utilities for representing, translating, and manipulating chat messages, including content blocks, provider-specific message translation, and chat history management.

nodes.label: Core LLM Interfaces
nodes.title: Language Model Interfaces Module
nodes.description: Defines abstract base classes for various language models (LLMs, chat models) and provides concrete implementations or wrappers for interacting with external LLM providers.

nodes.label: External LLM Provider
nodes.title: External Language Model Service
nodes.description: Represents an external Large Language Model service (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) that processes prompts and generates raw text or structured responses.

nodes.label: Output Parsing
nodes.title: Output Parsing Module
nodes.description: Contains parsers to convert raw language model outputs into structured formats like lists, JSON, or Pydantic objects, supporting both synchronous and streaming results.

nodes.label: Application Output
nodes.title: Structured Application Output
nodes.description: The final, processed, and structured data or response consumed by the application after being generated by the LLM and transformed by output parsers.

groups.label: Input Preparation
groups.title: Input Preparation & Context Management
groups.description: This group handles the initial stages of LLM interaction, including constructing prompts from user input and managing conversational history.

groups.label: LLM Interaction Core
groups.title: Language Model Interaction Core
groups.description: This group defines the central interfaces for interacting with various language models and manages the direct communication with external LLM providers.

groups.label: Output Processing
groups.title: Output Processing & Structuring
groups.description: This group is responsible for transforming the raw, unstructured output from language models into a usable, structured format for the application.
